concordance.note: A prostatectomy cohort, so it under-represents the low-grade disease that never reaches surgery. Read the row shares against the cohort's own grade distribution rather than against the population.

state-confined.cohort_note: Prostatectomy specimens: disease that was operable and had not been treated with anything systemic when it was sampled.

cohort.name: Metastatic Prostate Adenocarcinoma (SU2C/PCF Dream Team, PNAS 2019)

state-crpc-adeno.cohort_note: Biopsies of metastases taken after androgen deprivation stopped working. Most had also had abiraterone or enzalutamide.

state-nepc.cohort_note: The transformed form, sampled directly. A small cohort, and the only one that shows what the transformation does to the genome.
